head: 8226df63c268d7d521b648bcea1e655749362759
summary:
All four findings still held and are fixed. Each fix has a test that failed before the fix and passes after it.
- **HF-010:** T-005 is out of `-Case All` and runs only when named, as M-001 does.
- **HF-013:** SMBLibrary 1.5.8.1 and SMBLibrary.Win32 1.5.8 are now set once, as properties in Directory.Build.props, and both Core.Tests and StallRig take their versions from there.
- **HF-027:** New-CaseFolder and the TempTree constructor (now through TempTree.CreateRoot) refuse, by name, a folder that comes out NTFS-compressed, and delete it again. New-File now writes bytes that do not compress (TempTree's Random(20) pattern).
- **HF-028:** the hook's two UI-thread callbacks (WatchList's Background-priority refresh callback and Measure's ScanningPanel visibility handler) are wrapped in try/catch that logs 'refused mode=... reason=...'. A new hook variable, FSA_HOOK_RENAMED, lets HookCases H-003 feed the hook a missing window property.

Results: the full suite passed 400/400 and the bug catalog passed 10/10. HookCases All passed. T-005 passes when named. WindowCases `-Case All` fails only T-003, which fails the same way at HEAD because the display is too short (see tests).

files.why: HF-010: T-005 removed from the -Case All list, and the header and T-005 comments now say it runs only when named, as M-001 does. HF-027: New-CaseFolder refuses and deletes a folder that comes out NTFS-compressed, New-File writes Random(20) bytes, and the header's on-disk claim is updated. HF-028: FSA_HOOK_RENAMED added to $HookVariables so Invoke-WithHook sets it for one launch and then removes it.
HF-013: FsaSmbLibraryVersion (1.5.8.1) and FsaSmbLibraryWin32Version (1.5.8), each defined once.
HF-013: the SMBLibrary and SMBLibrary.Win32 PackageReferences take $(FsaSmbLibraryVersion) and $(FsaSmbLibraryWin32Version).
HF-013: the same two PackageReferences take the same shared properties.

HF-028: try/catch that logs 'refused' around WatchList's Background-priority callback and around Measure's ScanningPanel visibility handler. Also FSA_HOOK_RENAMED (watch and measure only; any other mode is refused) makes WindowState read that property as missing, so a case can feed the failure in.

HF-028 test: H-003 runs watch with LastRefresh missing and measure with SkippedRefreshes missing. Each run must end with exit 0, a report, and a 'refused ... the window has no X' line. Invoke-HookedRun and Show-Exit are added to the helpers it loads.
HF-027: the constructor creates its root through a new internal static CreateRoot, which refuses (and deletes) a root that comes out NTFS-compressed.
GetCompressedFileSizeW as TestNative.SizeOnDisk, used by the New-File test. Fixture interop is allowed only in this file (InteropLivesOnlyInNative).
HF-010 and HF-027 tests. Each loads WindowCases.ps1's parse through pwsh and reads the All branch's case list, or loads only New-CaseFolder or New-File by name, as HookCases.ps1 does.
HF-027 test for TempTree: a root under a compressed folder is refused by name and not left behind; a root under a plain folder is made.

HF-013 test: Directory.Build.props defines each pin exactly once, and every csproj under tests that references SMBLibrary or SMBLibrary.Win32 takes the shared property. Core.Tests and StallRig must both be among them.

tests.note: The worktree had no .dotnet/ and the machine has only SDK 8 and 9. eng/dotnet.ps1 installed SDK 10.0.401 into the gitignored .dotnet/ (Q-003).

RED, before any fix: 5 failed, 1 passed (the plain-folder TempTree test). AllLeavesOutTheTimingCases: All runs T-005. NewCaseFolderRefuses: the folder was made. NewFileTakesItsSizeOnDisk: expected 65536, actual 0, which reproduces the finding. TempTree refusal: no exception. SmbLibraryPin: literal versions.

RED, with FSA_HOOK_RENAMED in place but no try/catch: watch with LastRefresh missing and measure with SkippedRefreshes missing both ended with the app's exit 70, no report and no refused line, exactly as HF-028 predicted.

GREEN after the try/catch. Watch logged 'refused mode=watch reason=InvalidOperationException: the window has no LastRefresh', then still watched and pressed Cancel; exit 0 with a report. Measure logged the SkippedRefreshes refusal; exit 0 with a report.
9 of 9 passed. This includes WindowCasesIsAscii and the parse under both 5.1 and 7, so the edited script is still ASCII and parses under both.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 build tests/window/StallRig/StallRig.csproj -c Release -o artifacts/stall-rig
tests.note: Built with 0 warnings. Both obj/project.assets.json files (StallRig and Core.Tests) list SMBLibrary/1.5.8.1 and SMBLibrary.Win32/1.5.8, resolved through the shared properties.
Full suite: 400 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 23 s (FsAnalyser.Core.Tests, the only test project in the slnx).

The real entry point, run against the published app. Every case passed except T-003, and T-005 was not run. N-001..N-004 were NOT RUN (no -IncludeNetwork). T-003's one failure is 'VOID unless the taller window gave the tree more room than the default (241.9 px against 241.9 px)'. The default window is already 816 px tall, the whole work area (windowHeight 816, workAreaHeight 816), so no taller window can exist on this display. This slice changes nothing in the app, in TreeMode or in window sizing.

Baseline: HEAD's own WindowCases.ps1 (from git show HEAD:), copied next to the script for $PSScriptRoot and deleted afterwards. T-003 failed identically: windowHeight 816 = workAreaHeight 816, and the same VOID check. The failure predates this slice and depends on the display.
H-001, H-002 and H-003 passed. They use WindowCases' changed New-CaseFolder and New-File through HookCases' by-name loading.

T-005 still runs when named and prints its numbers: the window moved 36 times; five phases sampled. Longest waits: scan 85 ms, handoff 0.6 ms, open 93 ms, rescan 47 ms, rescan-handoff 0.5 ms. The p95 was under 28 ms in every phase.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~<each case test>"
tests.note: Each case's command was run exactly as reported, plus TempTreeTests.ATreeRootUnderACompressedFolderIsRefusedByName and WindowCasesHelperTests.NewCaseFolderRefusesACompressedTempByName. Every filter matched exactly 1 test, and each passed.

deviations: HF-028: the design names only the try/catch. To feed the failure into a test, I also added a hook variable, FSA_HOOK_RENAMED (watch and measure only; any other mode is refused), which makes WindowState read that one property as missing. I added it to WindowCases.ps1's $HookVariables so it is set for one launch only. Without it the only way to reach the throw is renaming a property in the shipped app, which the rule 'the shipped app carries no test seam' forbids. It changes nothing when unset.

HF-027: so the refusal could be tested without compressing the shared %TEMP%\fsa-tests that parallel test classes use, TempTree's root creation moved into an internal static TempTree.CreateRoot(string). The constructor calls it, and TempTreeTests calls it directly on a compressed folder under a TempTree.
follow_ups: T-003's check 'VOID unless the taller window gave the tree more room than the default' fails on this PC's current display, because the default window already fills the 816 px work area. It fails the same way at HEAD, so `WindowCases.ps1 -Case All` exits 1 here whatever the code does. The check should report VOID (not FAIL) when the default window already fills the work area, or the case should say it needs a taller display.

The person-run network pass (docs/design/SL-020-scanner.md staleness rule) was already stale. This slice touches more of its watched paths: tests/window/FsaWindowHook/**, tests/window/StallRig/**, tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 and FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.csproj. N-001..N-004 and StalledShareTests (O-030) are still owed to a person. StallRig was built here, but no network case was run.

WindowCases.ps1 still writes all-zero files outside New-File: the lone and denied-folder files near Test-B*, the long-path P-001 files, and New-HundredThousand. The New-CaseFolder refusal now covers them, but they would compress in a compressed folder if they were ever made outside a case folder.

Tree and reveal modes return before the hook's FSA_HOOK_RENAMED check, so either mode ignores the variable silently rather than refusing it. This does no harm, because neither mode reads the window's refresh state.
